waybackify manifest [flags] <file.md>

Per-file enumeration of wayback refs

Per-file enumeration of wayback refs. Inline links only by default;
--ledger folds in the sibling wayback.json entries. Corpus scope is
deliberately NOT built in — that is
`find words -name index.md | xargs waybackify manifest`.

Output: JSONL, {post, source: inline|ledger, timestamp, originalUrl,
waybackUrl}.

Arguments:
  <file.md>   markdown file to enumerate

Flags:
  --ledger    also fold in the sibling wayback.json ledger entries
  --help|-h   Show help

part of the wayback.charlie.dev mirror tooling
